name: Jayden Hindley
summary: I'm a Junior IT Technician at the University of Huddersfield, working across technical support, secure infrastructure and automation. I enjoy turning complicated problems into reliable, documented systems.

My work includes PowerShell and Python scripting, remote support, monitoring, backups and recovery, access controls, asset management and technology deployments. I also help colleagues understand new systems through training and knowledge sharing.

I keep learning through workshops, webinars and independent study, with interests in cybersecurity, ethical hacking, network security, cloud computing, AI and the Internet of Things. Clear communication, teamwork and mentoring matter as much to me as the technology.

education.title: Level 4 DevOps Engineer Apprenticeship
details: Completed the BCS Level 4 DevOps Engineer Apprenticeship while working at the University of Huddersfield.
Developed skills in automation, scripting, CI/CD, infrastructure, security, testing and monitoring, using PowerShell, Bash and Python.

End-Point Assessment: built an automated PowerShell solution using Microsoft Intune and deployment pipelines to identify stale user profiles and remove legacy Microsoft Teams installations. Work included scheduled remediation, testing, pilot deployment and compliance monitoring.
Professional discussion: Distinction. Also covered root cause analysis and incident postmortems.
